create_strip_token_dataset: create a StripTokenDataset that wraps a dataset and strips a specified token ID from sequence ends
use_strip_token_dataset_getitem: use StripTokenDataset getitem to retrieve a sequence with leading and trailing token IDs removed
strip_tokens_from_sequences: strip specified token IDs from both ends of sequences in a Fairseq dataset using StripTokenDataset
